reasons.plausibility: Drawing on well-established mechanisms of ALD coatings as effective diffusion barriers and mechanical reinforcements, the proposal that an Al2O3/TiO2 nanolaminate improves surface durability under aggressive conditions is scientifically sound.
reasons.testability: It provides a clear experimental design referencing both coated and uncoated controls under well-defined, reproducible environmental loads to measure hardness, wear, and corrosion, making it straightforward to verify or refute.
reasons.usefulness: This approach is both relevant to practical industrial and aerospace challenges and offers a potentially effective solution that researchers could readily investigate.
